{{Quote|Analysis of the vocal characteristics of your pilot, Hawk-bat One, suggests that he was probably, though not definitely, an Ewok. But I don't understand how that could be possible.|[[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] to [[Garik Loran]]|<ref name="if">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> }}
'''Hawk-bat One''' was a title and [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] when [[Wraith Squadron]] was masquerading as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group called the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]].<ref name="if" />

In order to hide their true identities, the Wraiths had their comm systems modified to alter the sound of their voice transmissions. As a prank, Wedge's comm system was altered to sound like an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]]. [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s forces obtained records of the Wraith's transmissions and informed the Warlord. Zsinj then questioned [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garik Loran|Kargin]]&mdash;[[Garik Loran]] in disguise&mdash;when he was invited to the [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']] for negotiations.<ref name="if" />
